_note: EN draft v0.1 (2026-11-03). Numbers checked by web search on 2026-11-03 (sources listed per market). verify:true = not confirmed this session or source conflict; check before launch. Re-check every number every 6 months. Market choice pending CSO decision.

US.crisis_line: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: call or text 988
US.crisis_text: Crisis Text Line: text HOME to 741741
US.dv_line: National Domestic Violence Hotline: 1-800-799-7233 (or text START to 88788)
US.verify_notes: Crisis Text Line keyword: most sources say HOME; one source (UMN) lists HELLO. Any keyword reaches a counselor, but confirm the wording on crisistextline.org.

UK.verify_notes: gov.uk page lists Shout 85258 in text but 85285 in one heading (typo on their side); 85258 is the number used by Shout. National Domestic Abuse Helpline covers England; Scotland/Wales/NI have separate lines.

CA.crisis_line: 988 Suicide Crisis Helpline: call or text 988
CA.dv_line: find a shelter or helpline near you at sheltersafe.ca
CA.youth_line: Kids Help Phone: 1-800-668-6868 (or text CONNECT to 686868)
CA.verify_notes: Brief said 'Talk Suicide Canada 988'. Talk Suicide Canada was the earlier line; since Nov 2023 the national service is the '988 Suicide Crisis Helpline' (CBC). Use the 988 name. Canada has no single national DV phone line; ShelterSafe lists shelters by province. 911 is not available everywhere in Nunavut (ShelterSafe).

AU.verify_notes: Lifeline text is not 24/7 (12pm-midnight, local time not stated in source - confirm time zone on lifeline.org.au). Kids Helpline is for ages 5-25.

GLOBAL.crisis_line: find a free helpline in your country at findahelpline.com

_fallback_rule: Unknown or unsupported country -> GLOBAL. Never show another country's number.
